ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity (black) to 30% high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity black central core extending from the peduncle to the median notch; high-intensity white mottling and stippling concentrated primarily on the distal one-third of both left and right lobes, with fine white punctate clusters dispersed throughout the central black regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 105 degrees; moderate bounding-box depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern featuring prominent, non-uniform peaks on the inner half of both trailing edges; higher frequency, lower amplitude variations observed toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve characterized by a concave trajectory near the median notch transitioning into a convex sweep toward the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, circular white pixel groupings (consistent with barnacle colonization) located on the extreme leading-edge tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous multi-directional, fine white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated heavily on the mid-to-distal section of the right lobe and the lower mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant clusters of ectoparasitic organisms (barnacles) on the distal tips and extensive rake-mark scarring across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The barnacle clusters on the leading edge tips create a distinct irregular silhouette that protrudes beyond the natural geometric curve of the fluke lobes.
